complete_examples.text: Since the axle box acceleration (ABA) along a railway line can be measured by one acceleration sensor and the ABA obtained from a in-service vehicle can generally reflect the wheel–rail interaction, the ABA-measuring approach [18–21] is therefore widely used to detect track deterioration in recent years, e.g. track geometry defects [18], track squats [19,20] and bolt loosing of rail joints [21], etc.
